summary: Completed focused live testing of sales APIs and the new desktop sales workflow.

ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar links are display:none at mobile width and no mobile menu control exists, so users cannot navigate to Penjualan from the mobile dashboard without a direct URL or header shortcut.

action_items: Add a visible mobile navigation/menu or ensure all workspace routes are reachable from mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/sales checks availability and then updates inventory in separate operations; concurrent requests can oversell stock without an atomic conditional update or transaction.
SalesPage initial inventory/sales Promise.all has no catch or loading/empty state, so a failed request can leave a blank form/list without user feedback.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (desktop sales flow passed; mobile navigation gap)

seed_data_creation: Created three TEST_Sales sales transactions through regression/UI checks; inventory stock was correspondingly reduced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API tests passed authentication, no _id serialization, Offline/Bazar/Marketplace calculations, stock decrement, and 409 oversell handling. Desktop UI passed channel/SKU controls, Marketplace submission, invoice/profit feedback, and header routing. Mobile sidebar is hidden with no replacement menu; direct mobile sales overflow assertion was not completed due to navigation limitation.
rca of the issue: At max-width 600px the existing aside navigation is hidden by CSS/layout, while Shell has no mobile drawer/menu state or trigger. The nav selector resolves but is hidden, preventing normal mobile route navigation. The sales API's read-then-write inventory logic is also not atomic under concurrent requests.
